def search_notes_by_title(self, user_id: str, query: str) -> list[Note]:\n    return [n for n in self.list_notes(user_id) if query.lower() in n.title.lower()]

import pytest
from notes_app.models import Note
from notes_app.notes import NotesService
from notes_app.notes_app import NotesApp
import os

def test_search_notes_by_title(app_with_user: NotesApp) -> None:
    note1 = app_with_user.create_note('alice', 'Search Test 1', 'Search content 1')
    note2 = app_with_user.create_note('alice', 'Search Test 2', 'Search content 2')
    result = app_with_user.notes.search_notes_by_title('alice', 'search')
    assert len(result) == 2
    assert result[0].title == 'Search Test 1'
    assert result[1].title == 'Search Test 2'
